audit_items.proof_trace: No validation enforces strict ordering of fork epochs (GENESIS < ALTAIR < BELLATRIX < CAPELLA < DENEB < ELECTRA < FULU). The ToForkVersion switch statement (slottime.go:75-93) evaluates newest-to-oldest with >= comparisons; if epochs are out-of-order, it returns incorrect fork versions causing state transition failures and consensus splits.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An attacker supplies a malformed config YAML with ElectraForkEpoch=10 and DenebForkEpoch=100. For epoch 50, ToForkVersion returns Electra (wrong) instead of Deneb, causing the node to apply wrong state transition rules, reject valid blocks, and diverge from consensus.
